about: Thresholds for tools/sfx_check.py, from the 47 sound specs and the 검수 critique of 2026-10-07. A rule is metric: [lo, hi] (a miss = WARN) or {range: [lo, hi], hard: [lo, hi]} (a hard miss = FAIL: do not listen). null = open end. Measured at speed 1.0 on the file as played; speedChecks measure the same file at game PlaybackSpeeds. Loudness is never a hard fail (a gain fixes it); summary.json gives gainToTargetDb.

loudness.note: Every file is normalised to the same K-weighted loudness (loudest 100 ms, BS.1770 weighting, short sounds counted over 100 ms); the in-game tier comes from Volume. effLufs = lufs + 20 log10(Volume) must sit in the tier band = target + 20 log10(tier Volume range) +- tolerance.
